items.title: Federal appeals court clears way for Trump hush-money appeal
items.feedTitle: Federal appeals court gives President Donald Trump a path to erasing hush money conviction
items.summary: A federal appeals court has opened a pathway for President Trump to potentially overturn his hush-money conviction by moving the case to federal court, where he could argue that prosecutors relied on evidence protected by presidential immunity. The ruling gives Trump a procedural advantage in challenging the state-level conviction, though the final outcome remains uncertain. Legal experts say the decision marks a significant development in the ongoing litigation.

items.title: House ethics panel finds evidence of sexual misconduct by Rep. Gomez
items.feedTitle: Ethics probe finds Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez made unwelcome sexual advances to a staffer
items.summary: The House Ethics Committee released a report on Monday finding "substantial evidence" that Democratic Representative Jimmy Gomez of California engaged in sexual misconduct, including making unwelcome sexual advances and sexual contact toward a House staffer. The report was released after the congressman lost his re-election bid. Gomez is expected to resign from Congress following the findings.

items.title: Army plans lead azide detonation in Iowa amid safety concerns
items.feedTitle: Trump told the Army to pause the detonation of 9,500 pounds of lead azide in Iowa. Here's what to know
items.summary: The U.S. Army's planned detonation of approximately 9,500 pounds of degraded lead azide in Iowa is expected to produce a plume of dust containing lead particles that could extend as far as 100 miles, according to environmental assessments. Residents, lawmakers, and environmental groups have raised concerns about insufficient communication regarding the detonation plan. The timing and final approval remain in flux after court involvement and statements from political figures.

items.title: ICE arrests at Seattle airport raise enforcement tactic questions
items.feedTitle: Seattle airport arrests renew protests over ICE enforcement tactics
items.summary: New questions about ICE's training and enforcement tactics have emerged following the arrest of a father and daughter as they were boarding a flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport. The incident has drawn criticism from local officials and prompted investigations into the Department of Homeland Security's practices. The arrests have renewed scrutiny on immigration enforcement procedures.

items.title: Pennsylvania confirms ninth measles-related death in 2026
items.feedTitle: Pennsylvania confirms 9th measles-related death
items.summary: Pennsylvania health officials confirmed the state's ninth measles-related death this year, occurring in an unvaccinated Centre County resident. The death comes less than a week after the U.S. lost its measles elimination status after more than 25 years, marking a significant public health setback. CDC and state figures on measles deaths differ, adding complexity to the ongoing state outbreak.

stlouis.title: St. Louis residents face potential lead exposure from Iowa detonation
stlouis.feedTitle: What St. Louis residents need to know about the lead azide detonations in Iowa
stlouis.summary: St. Louis residents need to understand the implications of the Army's planned lead azide detonation in Iowa, as the resulting dust plume could potentially travel hundreds of miles and affect air quality in the region. Local news outlets are providing guidance on what residents should know about the facility in Iowa and any associated risks. This regional environmental concern has become increasingly relevant to the St. Louis metro area.

stlouis.title: St. Louis families struggle with childcare versus bills trade-off
stlouis.feedTitle: Paying for childcare or paying bills? St. Louis families face tough choices
stlouis.summary: Families in the St. Louis area face difficult financial decisions between paying for childcare and meeting other essential expenses like utilities and rent. The report highlights the ongoing economic pressures facing working families in the region. These affordability challenges reflect broader economic strain in the community.

stlouis.title: Siblings killed, teen critically injured outside concert venue
stlouis.feedTitle: Police ask public for help after siblings killed, teen critically injured outside concert venue
stlouis.summary: Police are asking for public help after two siblings were killed and a teenager was critically injured in an incident outside a concert venue. The shooting represents a significant public safety incident in the St. Louis metro area. Investigators are seeking information from the community to help solve the case.

items.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after Trump intervenes
items.feedTitle: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after Trump intervenes
items.summary: Nvidia's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive after the company's founder had resigned amid revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence. President Trump personally intervened to push for his reinstatement, claiming he "convinced" the board to reverse its decision. The reinstatement triggered a dramatic market rally, adding approximately $1 trillion to Nvidia's stock value and sparking concerns over federal government involvement in corporate board decisions.

items.title: NATO chief vows defense against Russian space nuclear threats
items.feedTitle: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
items.summary: NATO chief has pledged that the alliance will defend against threats in space after German media reported that Russia may be planning to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks. The statement reflects growing concerns about military escalation in the space domain. NATO is signaling its commitment to treating space as part of the collective defense pledge.

items.title: Malaysia plans to send thousands of migrants back to Myanmar
items.feedTitle: Malaysia to send thousands of migrants back to Myanmar as PM acknowledges junta’s ‘atrocities’
items.summary: Malaysia says it will send thousands of migrants and refugees back to Myanmar, despite acknowledging that many asylum seekers in the country had been victims of "atrocities." Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's announcement comes days after the International Court of Justice found Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya minority. The move raises concerns from humanitarian groups about the safety of returnees.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian warship in Libya, escalating conflict scope
items.feedTitle: Ukrainian naval drones strike a new Russian warship in Libya, and other Mideast news
items.summary: Ukraine says it destroyed a Russian warship in Libya using naval drones, marking a significant expansion of the conflict beyond Eastern Europe. The sinking of the Russian battleship demonstrates Ukraine's capability to strike military targets far from its borders. The incident raises the geopolitical stakes of the ongoing war and shows how the conflict is spreading into new theaters.

items.title: COP31 climate talks collapse over fossil fuel disagreements
items.feedTitle: Failure of Cop31 prompts calls for urgent reform of UN climate summits
items.summary: International climate talks at COP31 in Turkey ended without reaching a final agreement after two weeks of negotiations, described as the longest-running climate summit in UN history. The failure to agree reflects deep divisions between oil-producing countries, US participation concerns, and disputes over climate finance obligations. Experts and observers are calling for urgent reform of the UN climate summit process.

items.title: India pledges $1.6 billion flood relief for Nepal
items.feedTitle: India pledges $1.6bn in flood relief for Nepal as Balendra Shah visits Modi
items.summary: India unveiled a Rs 15,000 crore (approximately $1.6 billion) development package for Nepal during a state visit by Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah to India's PM Modi. The announcement signals India's commitment to strengthening bilateral ties and supporting Nepal's development priorities. The package reflects India's broader diplomatic engagement with its Himalayan neighbor and comes as the two countries work to strengthen their partnership.

items.title: School truck collision kills four children in Uttar Pradesh
items.feedTitle: At least four children killed, 32 injured as truck rams stationary school bus in U.P.’s Kannauj
items.summary: At least four children were killed and 32 others injured when a truck collided with a stationary school bus in Kannauj, Uttar Pradesh. The bus was carrying 50 people, including students returning from an excursion to the Taj Mahal in Agra. The incident highlights ongoing road safety concerns in India and raises questions about vehicle safety standards and driver protocols.

items.title: Delhi man stabs nine police officers at Jama Masjid station
items.feedTitle: Delhi man stabs 9 policemen at Jama Masjid police station, shot in encounter after escape
items.summary: A man stabbed nine Delhi police officers in twin knife attacks at the Jama Masjid police station before being shot eight times in an encounter after he escaped. The incident represents a serious breach of security at a major police facility in the capital. Officers were treated for injuries sustained during the violent incident.

items.title: Cockroach Janta Party leader stopped from flying to UK
items.feedTitle: Saurav Das: Cockroach Janta Party leader says he was stopped from flying to UK for Oxford event
items.summary: Saurav Das, leader of the Cockroach Janta Party, said that immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him his passport had been "flagged" and prevented him from boarding a flight to the UK for an Oxford University event. Das characterized the incident as government censorship of opposition voices. The case raises questions about passport flagging procedures and their use.

items.title: Kerala police probe toxic cosmetics' link to kidney disease
items.feedTitle: Kerala: Police investigate fairness cream's alleged link to kidney ailment in 17-year-old Indian girl
items.summary: Kerala police are investigating a fairness cream's alleged link to kidney ailment in a 17-year-old girl, as authorities have launched a statewide crackdown on toxic face creams. The case has prompted wider scrutiny of unsafe cosmetics being sold and promoted online. Influencers and sellers of unsafe cosmetics may face legal action under the investigation.

immigration.title: DOL proposes sweeping overhaul of PERM labor certification
immigration.feedTitle: Modernizing the Labor Market Test and Improving Protections for U.S. Workers in the PERM Immigrant Visa Program
immigration.summary: The U.S. Department of Labor has proposed significant changes to the PERM labor certification process, which governs permanent labor certification for employers seeking to employ foreign workers on a permanent basis. The proposed rule, published in the Federal Register, aims to strengthen standards for the labor market test and improve protections for U.S. workers. Status: proposed, not final. The changes would affect employers seeking EB-3 green cards and other employment-based immigration categories, particularly in healthcare and other industries.

immigration.title: November visa bulletin shows EB-3 green card date advances for India
immigration.feedTitle: US Visa Bulletin November 2026: EB-2 unchanged, EB-3 Green Card dates advance for India
immigration.summary: The November 2026 visa bulletin shows that EB-3 green card dates advanced for India, while EB-2 dates remained unchanged. Status: finalized and in effect. The visa bulletin is the primary mechanism by which USCIS allocates employment-based green cards by priority date. India typically faces significant backlogs in employment-based categories due to country-per-visa limits.

immigration.title: Democrats propose new green card route for deportation-at-risk immigrants
immigration.feedTitle: US Green Card: Democrats propose new route to permanent residency for immigrants facing deportation
immigration.summary: Democratic lawmakers have proposed the Protect Our Neighbors Act, which would create a new pathway to permanent residency for immigrants facing deportation after 10-year orders expire. Status: proposed, not final. The proposal targets long-term undocumented immigrants who have deep roots in the U.S. community but lack legal status. The route would apply to certain categories of immigrants who have been in the country for extended periods.

items.title: Stocks surge in best day since 2025 on Jensen Huang reinstatement
items.feedTitle: Stocks Surge After Jensen Huang Is Reinstated as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: U.S. stocks experienced their best trading day since April 2025 after Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq posting significant gains. The reinstatement sparked a broad market rally, adding approximately $3 trillion in market value globally as investor confidence in AI technology recovered. The rally reversed weeks of losses driven by concerns over AI spending efficiency and profitability.

items.title: Commerce Department blacklists Megaspeed amid Nvidia scandal
items.feedTitle: Trump administration blacklists Megaspeed, key firm in Nvidia scandal
items.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department added Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company at the center of Nvidia's national security scandal, to its trade entity blacklist. The move was published in the Federal Register and aims to tighten scrutiny on companies potentially involved in circumventing AI chip export controls. Megaspeed has been accused of involvement in funneling advanced AI chips to China after a former Nvidia executive's affair with a suspected Chinese spy became public.

items.title: Indian markets plunge 1.8% as profit-taking ends four-week rally
items.feedTitle: Sensex Today Tanks 1,484 Points | Nifty Below 25,350 | 4 Reasons Why Indian Share Markets Are Falling
items.summary: India's stock markets fell nearly 2% on Monday with the Sensex dropping 1,484 points and the Nifty declining 1.75%, as profit-taking ended a four-week rally. Banking stocks led the decline, with investors erasing approximately Rs 5.6 trillion in market capitalization. The sell-off followed record gains and reflected concerns about valuation levels after the recent run-up.

items.title: Oil prices linger near three-month low despite Hormuz risks
items.feedTitle: Oil Near Three-Month Low as Rising Supply Counters Hormuz Risks
items.summary: Oil prices remain near three-month lows despite geopolitical tensions and reported risks in the Strait of Hormuz, as rising global supply continues to outweigh demand concerns. The disconnect reflects market expectations that supply disruptions can be managed and that demand growth remains subdued. Analysts suggest oil may remain range-bound absent major geopolitical escalation.

items.title: Trump profits estimated at $12-15 million from Nvidia share gains
items.feedTitle: Trump made up to $15mn on Nvidia shares after Huang’s return
items.summary: President Trump's portfolio benefited from Nvidia's dramatic price surge following Jensen Huang's reinstatement, with reported gains estimated at $12 to $15 million based on Trump's disclosed shareholdings. Trump personally intervened to convince Nvidia's board to reinstate Huang, raising questions about potential conflicts of interest. The timing of Trump's involvement and market impact has drawn scrutiny from lawmakers and ethics watchdogs.

cards.title: The Deadline Illusion
cards.insight: Many professionals confuse urgency with importance. A 2 PM meeting feels productive because it's imminent, while deep work on quarterly goals gets postponed. The pressure of deadlines often crowds out the work that actually moves the needle.
cards.takeaway: Block your calendar for three 90-minute slots weekly labeled "Deep Work"—treat them as immovable client meetings. Schedule them for your peak energy hours.

cards.title: Context Switching Costs More Than You Think
cards.insight: Research shows it takes 15–25 minutes to regain full cognitive focus after an interruption. Checking email or Slack once per hour cuts your effective working time by roughly 25%, even if each check takes just 2 minutes.
cards.takeaway: Establish "communication windows"—e.g., email at 9am, noon, and 3pm only. Use tools like Slack's Do Not Disturb mode to signal when you're unavailable, and batch responses rather than reacting in real-time.

cards.title: Energy Management Beats Time Management
cards.insight: A tired person with eight free hours accomplishes less than a rested person with four. Yet most productivity advice focuses on squeezing more output from the same energy supply. This is unsustainable and leads to burnout.
cards.takeaway: Before adding another task or optimization, audit your sleep, movement, and meal timing. A 20-minute walk or 30 minutes of sleep often yields more productivity gain than reorganizing your to-do list.

cards.title: The Default Distraction Is Your Own Device
cards.insight: Willpower is finite. Notifications, app icons, and browser tabs are designed to hijack attention. Relying on discipline alone to resist them is like trying to stay dry in a rainstorm with no umbrella.
cards.takeaway: Use friction: silence your phone entirely during focus blocks, close all browser tabs except one, and use app blockers (Freedom, Cold Turkey) to remove options during deep work windows. Make distraction require deliberate action.

ai.title: Anthropic claims Claude proved VP ≠ VNP mathematical conjecture
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic says Claude proved VP ≠ VNP, tackling Valiant’s 47-year-old conjecture
ai.summary: Anthropic announced that its Claude AI model has produced a proof of VP ≠ VNP, one of the most famous unsolved problems in computer science and mathematics, addressing Valiant's 47-year-old conjecture. However, the claimed proof runs to approximately 250,000 pages of dense mathematical reasoning, raising questions about verifiability and practical utility. The claim represents Anthropic's attempt to demonstrate advanced reasoning capabilities of Claude, though the mathematical community has not yet validated the work.

ai.title: States sue Musk companies over Grok AI-generated sexual imagery
ai.feedTitle: States sue Musk companies over flood of sexualized images made with AI chatbot Grok
ai.summary: Oregon and Virginia filed lawsuits against Musk-owned X and SpaceX over Grok, an AI chatbot that allegedly generates child sex abuse material and non-consensual intimate images. The states allege that the companies lack adequate safeguards to prevent the tool from creating illegal content. The litigation represents regulatory pressure on AI companies to implement stronger content moderation and safety mechanisms.

ai.title: OpenAI and Cisco unveil AI-assisted Linux security tool Shirudo
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI and Cisco Unveil AI-Assisted Linux Security Tool to Block Exploits Before Patching
ai.summary: OpenAI and Cisco have jointly developed Shirudo, an AI-assisted tool designed to block Linux security exploits before patches are available. The tool uses AI to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities in real-time, addressing the lag between when exploits are discovered and when patches are deployed. The collaboration demonstrates a practical application of AI in enterprise cybersecurity.

ai.title: OpenAI chief scientist proposes limits on AI development
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI Chief Scientist Proposes Limits on AI Development
ai.summary: OpenAI's chief scientist has proposed implementing constraints on the pace of AI development to manage safety risks and ensure responsible advancement of the technology. The proposal suggests establishing guardrails and safeguards as AI capabilities continue to advance. The statement reflects ongoing industry debates about balancing innovation with risk mitigation.

ai.title: Anthropic launches zero-data-retention safeguards for Claude
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic Opens Beta for Zero-Retention AI Safeguards
ai.summary: Anthropic has expanded availability of its AI safety monitoring with a zero-data-retention option for Claude, allowing enterprise users to ensure their conversations are not retained for model improvement or other purposes. The beta feature addresses privacy and data security concerns from organizations using advanced AI models. The move represents Anthropic's effort to differentiate itself on privacy and security in a competitive AI market.
